observations: Black upholstery with gold-colored metal armrests and base.
Watermark 'DOMINGO GLOBAL DIGITAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' visible.
Background shows other salon equipment, suggesting a showroom or warehouse environment.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a barber chair, but the reclining mechanism is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump for height adjustment may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: Video showing the chair being pumped up and released down smoothly.

risks.risk: Reclining mechanism may be jammed or unable to lock in position.
risks.proof: Video showing the chair reclining to its full extent and returning to upright.

risks.risk: Hidden upholstery damage or heavy wear on the rear or underside.
risks.proof: Photos of the back and the opposite side of the chair.

proof_requests: Video of the hydraulic pump lifting and lowering the chair.
Video of the reclining mechanism in operation.
Photos of the back and the other side of the chair to check for upholstery damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly a barber chair. It can be priced at the worst-case value of a standard non-functional or fixed-position chair until the hydraulic and reclining features are proven to work.
